text:
Vampires don't exist in the U.S. or anywhere else, so you can't find real ones there. For vampire lore, Exeter, Rhode Island is the best-known stop, where villagers exhumed Mercy Brown in 1892 during a tuberculosis outbreak because they suspected she was a vampire. New Orleans, the setting of Anne Rice's vampire novels, is another place to explore the legends.

CONFIDENCE: 95
